title: A computational investigation on Rho-related GTP-binding protein RhoB through molecular modeling and molecular dynamics simulation study
authors: Shamrat Kumar Paul; Chowdhury Lutfun Nahar Metu; Sunita Kumari Sutihar; Md. Saddam; Bristi Paul; Md. Lutful Kabir; Md Mostofa Uddin Helal
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过同源建模和分子动力学模拟分析RhoB蛋白结构，但对象为GTP结合蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且未涉及DNA结合或转录因子机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Backgorund RhoB is a key member of the Rho family of isoprenylated small GTPases which modulate the cellular cytoskeletal organization. It has a crucial role in the neoplastic apoptotic mechanism after DNA damage. Due to the unavailability of 3D structure in the protein data bank database, in this study, we evaluated the structure of a protein, Rho-related GTP-binding protein RhoB. Results RhoB has a predicted pI of 5.10, indicating that it is acidic. The GMQE value was used to compute the target–template alignment, and 6hxu.1.A from Homo sapiens was chosen as the template structure, with the model construction task completed using swiss-model. The structural compactibility and stability were revealed after a 100ns molecular dynamics simulation using GROMACA employing the OPLS-AA force field. PCA analysis found residues that are relevant based on their fluctuation acitivity while their location is between 100-110 and 140-150. Conclusion This study will benefit future investigations addressing the association between gene mutation and abnormalities generated by protein Rho-related GTP-binding protein RhoB in apoptotic events by offering insight into the biophysical phenomenon of Rho-related GTP-binding protein RhoB inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 背景 RhoB是Rho家族异戊二烯化小GTP酶的关键成员，这些酶调节细胞骨架组织。它在DNA损伤后的肿瘤凋亡机制中发挥关键作用。由于蛋白质数据银行数据库中缺乏3D结构，本研究评估了蛋白质Rho相关GTP结合蛋白RhoB的结构。结果 RhoB的预测等电点（pI）为5.10，表明其为酸性。使用GMQE值计算目标-模板比对，并选择来自智人的6hxu.1.A作为模板结构，模型构建任务使用swiss-model完成。通过使用GROMACA和OPLS-AA力场进行100ns分子动力学模拟，揭示了结构的紧凑性和稳定性。PCA分析发现，基于其波动活性，位于100-110和140-150之间的残基具有相关性。结论 本研究通过提供对Rho相关GTP结合蛋白RhoB抑制剂生物物理现象的见解，将有助于未来研究基因突变与凋亡事件中蛋白质Rho相关GTP结合蛋白RhoB产生的异常之间的关联。
